spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Implement frontend typed terminal attachment, history-before-live rendering, and sequence de-duplication with RED-to-GREEN tests using the protocol-v2 DTO contract.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY ui/src/lib/types.ts, ui/src/lib/tauri.ts, ui/src/lib/tauri.test.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalTransport/types.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalTransport/tauriTransport.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalTransport/remoteTransport.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalTransport/terminalTransport.test.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalEvents.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalEvents.test.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalEvents.bus.test.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalOutputScheduler.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalInstanceFactory.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts, ui/src/lib/terminalHostManagerTestHelper.ts, and related terminalHostManager test files. The expected native DTO has decimal-string sequences and base64 history/output. Extend TerminalSession with optional daemonEpoch and lastOutputSequence; keep persisted wire values strings where appropriate. Implement attach IPC call, decode history, write history before live subscription, suppress output sequence <= historyEndSequence, resume after last applied sequence, and reset/replay on explicit gap. Tests must fail against the current dummy attach implementation and prove history-before-live plus duplicate suppression.
SCOPE: Own only the listed UI transport/renderer files. You may read daemon protocol and App state but do not edit them. Do not commit or revert unrelated files.
VERIFY: Run bun run --cwd ui test -- src/lib/tauri.test.ts src/lib/terminalTransport/terminalTransport.test.ts src/lib/terminalEvents.test.ts src/lib/terminalEvents.bus.test.ts src/lib/terminalHostManager.output.test.ts src/lib/terminalHostManager.test.ts and bun run --cwd ui build. Both must exit 0. Return RED/GREEN evidence and changed files.
STOP WHEN: The UI can consume the frozen protocol-v2 attachment DTO with ordered replay and all owned tests/build pass.
